description: The rates, thresholds and constants behind the buhalteris.ai calculators for 2026 or 2027: minimum monthly wage (MMA), average wage (VDU), tax-free amount (NPD), income tax (GPM) rates and brackets, Sodra contribution rates (VSD, PSD), contribution ceilings (lubos), business certificate amounts (verslo liudijimas) and small partnership (MB) profit tax and dividend rates. Use for "koks GPM tarifas", "kokia MMA", "Sodros įmokų tarifai", "NPD dydis". Money is in integer euro cents and rates in hundredths of a percent (permyriad): 1252 means 12.52 percent. `preliminary` lists the fields that still come from a draft; `computed` lists the amounts derived from MMA because the agency has not published them.
